issues.description: The loop was changed from reverse iteration to forward iteration while still calling `sessions.splice(i, 1)` during the loop. Removing index i shifts every later element down by one, but i still increments, so the element immediately after each removed one is skipped and never checked. Consecutive expired sessions are only half-pruned. Reverse iteration (the original) is exactly what avoids this; the refactor reintroduces the classic mutate-while-iterating bug.
